cohort: Singleton live-born infants from Burundi, Congo Democratic Republic, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda.
finding: Several factors, including male sex, small perceived birth size, first birth order, previous baby death, non-usage of contraceptives, no tetanus toxoid injection, no antenatal care, and delivery by caesarean section, were significantly associated with increased neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Delivery through caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of neonatal mortality (HR=1.89, 95% CI=1.40-2.55).
country: Burundi, Congo Democratic Republic, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda
cross-section timing: Most recent Demographic and Health Survey
